evidence.snippet: const isSelf = session.user.id === id; const isAdmin = session.user.role === 'ADMIN';
evidence.why: Authorization derived from server-verified session, not from client-supplied data
Role field only writable when session-verified isAdmin is true, preventing self-escalation

controls_present: admin check against session.user.role before role mutation
404 instead of 403 to avoid leaking existence (not security-relevant to this rubric but present)
